name: cicy-audit-policy
title: Audit Policy Admin
description: Configure the cicy AI-traffic audit policy and analyse its log via /api/audit/*: inspect, tighten, loosen or roll back rules, tune false positives, read events, snapshots, stats to adjudicate hits.
author: cicy-ai

zh-CN.title: 审计策略管理
zh-CN.description: 用自然语言审视、收紧、放松或回滚 cicy 的 AI 流量审计策略("脱敏银行卡号"、"让计费 agent 看到 SSN"、"我现在跑哪些规则?"、"撤销上一次改动")。读取 ~/cicy-ai/audit/policy.json,提出 patch,确认后经 /api/audit/policy 写回 —— 和 UI 审计台同一条写入路径,运行中的流水线会热重载。

tools.name: summary
tools.description: One-screen human view: enabled? fail-mode? overrides? allow-list? preventive?

tools.name: patch
tools.description: Deep-merge a JSON object into the policy and write it back

tools.name: set
tools.description: Set one field by dot-path (value parsed as JSON, else string)

tools.name: rule-test
tools.description: Dry-run a matcher (regex|js) against sample text before adding the rule — confirm it hits and check for false positives

tools.name: effective
tools.description: Print the merged policy actually in force for one agent (global ⊕ per-agent override)

tools.name: events
tools.description: List matched audit events, filtered by --severity/--agent/--direction/--rule (or a raw query string); --json for full objects

tools.name: event
tools.description: Full detail of a single audit event by id

tools.name: stats
tools.description: Hit aggregation by rule / agent / severity — find noisy rules or repeat offenders

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: Fetch the raw, un-redacted forensic snapshot referenced by an event (evidence; do not leak)

tools.name: agents
tools.description: List agents that have audit events

tools.name: recent
tools.description: Compact recent event list, optionally filtered by rule/agent

tools.name: allowlist
tools.description: Show the allow-list (content_hashes / paths / agents) that suppresses false-positive findings

tools.name: allowlist-add
tools.example: cicy-audit-policy allowlist-add sha256:<hash> "known FP — internal test fixture"
tools.description: Allow-list a finding by its content sha256 so identical content stops alerting

tools.name: allowlist-remove
tools.description: Remove one allow-list entry (category = content_hash | path | agent)

tools.name: history
tools.description: Show the git log of ~/cicy-ai/audit (autonomy auto-commits; manual edits do not)
